_note: Everything a student reads outside the chat (Vault, Background, Roadmap, paths) is written in this language and style, whatever language the student chats in. Only the Counselor's conversation follows the student's language.
style: Plain, standard and simple: short sentences, everyday words, no slang, one script. Translate the student's meaning; never copy their sentence. Keep proper names (people, places, institutions, official qualification titles) as written.
